content: आचक्ष् €2 <ab>Ā.</ab> ²1 To speak, announce, declare, teach, tell, relate, communicate, say, narrate (usually with <ab>dat.</ab> of person); गुरवे … प्रस्तुतमाचचक्षे <ls>R. 5. 19</ls>, <ls n="R.">12. 55</ls>, <ls n="R.">14. 36</ls>; <ls>Ms. 4. 59</ls>, <ls n="Ms. 4.">81</ls>; <ls>M. 5</ls>; इत्याख्यानविद आचक्षते <ls>Māl. 2</ls>; sometimes with <ab>acc.</ab>; तत्त्वां किमाचक्ष्महे <ls>Bv. 1. 63</ls> say to or address. .²2 To name, call, say; शर्व इति प्राच्या आचक्षते <ls>Śat. Br.</ls> .²3 To divine, bespeak; यथा मे हृदयमाचष्टे <ls>M. 4</ls>. .²4 To make known, acquaint, introduce to. .²5 To look at, inspect (<ab>Ved.</ab>). आ चष्ट आसां पाथो नदीनाम् <ls>Rv. 7. 34. 10</ls>.
